articles.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
articles.snippet: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.

articles.title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
articles.snippet: Blur’s planned website closure revived criticism of the royalty policies and token rewards that helped it overtake OpenSea during the NFT boom, but hurt creators.

articles.title: NFT Marketplace Blur to Shut Down Website, Stop New Blend Loans Next Month
articles.snippet: The shutdown comes as NFT trading volumes have collapsed from their 2021-2022 peak, with market revenue projected at $318 million this year.
